rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Referent resolution under a sequential deck read.
rules_evaluated.evidence: The closest possible bindings resolve in sequence: chunk 2 names the live challenge (line 8), chunk 5's 'the real one' and 'the challenge' point to that named challenge (line 29), and chunk 5 names the same session/task before 'the next exercise' (line 39).

The cross-file references name their documents by link text: 'Module 2 prework' (line 8), 'Agent Trigger List, After Module 2' and 'What is an Agent' (line 79). No body sentence points to an opening file, page position, or unnamed prior document.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Every backward reference points at a beat that exists.
rules_evaluated.evidence: Backward-looking beats are anchored to named or current-session work: Karpathy's LLM Wiki post is named in prework (line 8) before the recap at line 25, and the Module 1 rehearsal/site/guardrails work named at lines 21-23 and 54 is present in the training arc; no nonexistent 'you did/saw/caught' beat is claimed.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Live-demo beats survive a text read.
rules_evaluated.evidence: No guess/predict instruction followed by a reveal appears in the body; the demo link at line 35 is a named navigation pointer, not a text-read guess-before-reveal beat.
Every chunk carries a claim, instruction, concept, handoff, or next action; even the title-adjacent Big Idea chunk states a self-carrying claim, 'A system remembers, grows, and compounds' (line 4).

The closest orientation headers remain literal at slide scope: 'Sharpen where it bends' is immediately explained by watching where the agent bends and turning misses into context (lines 58-62), and 'Bring to Module 3' contains the artefact and observation handoff (lines 69-75).

A direct body read finds no Not-X/Not-Y/Z construction, empty anaphora triple, self-grading superlative, number retraction, abstraction-noun stack, or empty verb triplet. The line-29 pair 'Not a task. A challenge.' is a contrast pair, not the prohibited three-part construction.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Internal dialect never lands on a slide.
rules_evaluated.evidence: The body uses student-facing engineering terms such as 'rules file', 'memory', and 'session'; the repo-internal dialect examples compendium, firing, forcing function, beat, mood, and surface-as-noun appear only in the maintainer block or not at all, not in lines 1-89.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Emphasis budget — bold is for handles, and go very lightly.
rules_evaluated.evidence: Harm prevented: projection emphasis should identify handles rather than turn narrative into decoration. That harm is present nonblockingly in chunk 10: the whole sentence 'A daily agent, scheduled, with a week of observation behind it.' is bold (line 71), exceeding the approximately five-word handle cap and functioning as narrative carry-in rather than a short handle.
rules_evaluated.fix_hint: Reduce the bold treatment to a short artefact handle and leave the observation sentence in regular text.
